sloka: चुक्रुशुस्ते ततः सर्वे वानराः सविभीषणाः।हृष्यन्तो निहते तस्मिन् देवा वृत्रवधे यथा ।। ६.९१.७७ ।।
transliteration: cukruśuste tataḥ sarve vānarāḥ savibhīṣaṇāḥ।hṛṣyanto nihate tasmin devā vṛtravadhe yathā ।। 6.91.77 ।।

translations.english: Then Vibheeshana and all the Vanaras rejoiced just as Devas, when Vrtasura was killed.
